title: Visual Analytics for Efficient Image Exploration and User-Guided Image Captioning

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the frequency and co-occurrence of gender-specific words (e.g., 'man' vs. 'woman') with target objects (e.g., 'tie', 'skateboard', 'car') in automatically generated image captions using a visual node-link diagram to reveal imbalanced demographic representations in datasets like ImageNet and COCO.

Using a Co-Occurrence Graph generated from pre-trained language-image model captions to visually detect high-frequency, non-causal associations between target classes and specific background elements or contexts (e.g., 'wolf' co-occurring with 'snow', or 'tench' co-occurring with 'person holding').
